summary: An on-call aide explains why a substitute needs training even when the client’s routine is familiar to the regular worker.
realLife: Adams told senators that a relief assignment could put him in a home whose equipment he had never used, making training important to both people’s safety.
gates: A substitute is assigned and the equipment or orientation is on record.
inGame: needs: a substitute assignment, equipment and training records.

turns.what: A trained backup takes the assignment.
turns.pulledBy: The coordinator finds someone familiar with the equipment.
A qualified person can explain the equipment before the relevant task.
turns.writesBack: The start time or task assignment changes.
